name: Insatiable Frugivore
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a Food token, then you may exile three cards from your graveyard. If you do, repeat this process.
{3}{B}, Sacrifice X Foods: Creatures you control get +X/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: {3}{B}, Sacrifice X Foods: Creatures you control get +X/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that sacrifices a player-announced number X of permanents matching a selector (here Foods), with X announced at activation (601.2b, 107.3), bounded by the matching permanents the controller can sacrifice, and read back by the effects with {"x": true} -- the sacrifice analogue of `discard_x`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `sacrifice` in cost_keys takes a fixed integer `count` (costs.pay pops `count` as an int, default 1), and `x_value` defines an {X} in the mana cost rather than a sacrifice count; the only announced-X non-mana costs are `discard_x`, `loyalty_x` and `pay_life_x`. Sacrificing in an effect instead would move the payment to resolution, which the brief forbids
